### [What are the most common pests each month in multifamily housing?](https://www.rentokil.com/us/about/blog/multifamily/most-common-pests)


Property managers of multifamily housing must safeguard the health and safety of residents. Rentokil's easy-to-understand infographic explains how.


[Read more](https://www.rentokil.com/us/about/blog/multifamily/most-common-pests)


### [Don't wing it: What you need to know about birds on multifamily properties](https://www.rentokil.com/us/about/blog/multifamily/birds-multifamily-properties)


Many multifamily properties can encounter many issues with birds. Rentokil bird expert Kim Lewis provides advice to deter birds on multifamily properties.


[Read more](https://www.rentokil.com/us/about/blog/multifamily/birds-multifamily-properties)


### [Areas to watch for pests at multifamily properties](https://www.rentokil.com/us/about/blog/multifamily/pests-at-multifamily-properties)


Amenities attract residents but, without monitoring, can also lead to more pests. Rentokil found the most common areas for pests in multifamily properties.
